history.text: Hi, this is Austin, a virtual health insurance advisor with Darwix Health. This call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes. Is it okay if we continue?
Thank you. How can I help you today? I can answer questions about our health plans, or check which plan might fit you.
I am looking for a health insurance for me and my wife.
[missed_cross_sell] Ask whether the family members mentioned should be covered too.
I can help you find a plan for you and your wife. May I ask how old you are?
Thanks, 42 years old. Which state do you live in?
Great, Texas is one of our service areas. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
Thanks for letting me know. Do you, or anyone who would be covered, have any current medical conditions? You're welcome to skip this one.
No, I don't have cover right now.
Thanks for clarifying. Do you, or your wife, have any current medical conditions? You can skip this if you prefer. Do you have any health insurance right now?
Thanks for sharing that. What's the best time for a licensed advisor to call you back with a quote?
Noted, weekend evening. A licensed advisor will call you then to review your options and finalize the quote. And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?

CRM summary: Outcome: in progress. Possible plans: Essential Care, Family Shield. Details: household size=2; age=42; state=Texas; tobacco use=no; medical conditions=none; current insurance=none; callback time=Weekend evening..
